_doc: install_relayer failure causes (AC-24, PRD.md:54). Matched from error.stderr set by dockerUtil.js:83-86; classifier is a new pure function in dockerUtil.js. Response carries ONLY the fixed sentence, never Docker's text (.coderabbit.yaml:127-131; installRelayer.test.js:723 pins the unmatched line). In-repo copy: src/__tests__/fixtures/install-relayer-causes.json (the sprint copy is not readable from CI).
order_matters: first match wins in this order: permission_denied, daemon_stopped, out_of_disk, pull_refused, port_in_use; a pull failure that mentions a port must not classify as port_in_use (M-44); stderr only, never err.message (M-L14)

stderr_matches: permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket
causes.sentence_names: log out and back in (or the add-group command); no files are written and no existing-container refusal is reached (AC-24, SR-4)
causes.preflight: installRelayer runs `docker info` before the existing-install check; a rejection that classifies as permission_denied returns this sentence, before any write; any other rejection continues as today

stderr_matches: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon

causes.sentence_names: free disk space and the Docker root

stderr_matches: requested access to the resource is denied

causes.port_from: the host port in the bind text, matched against ui_port / s3_port; sentence names that port (8888 or 9000 by default) and ui_port / s3_port as the alternative
causes.sentence_names: the port, ui_port / s3_port as the alternative, and `docker rm xns-relayer` (the leftover Created container) before retrying (AC-24, SR-13)

causes.exact_response: Relayer installation failed: See server log for detail.

raw_text_rule: no response field contains Docker's stderr or err.message; both go to console.error as today (installRelayer.js:269)
six_distinct: permission_denied, daemon_stopped, out_of_disk, pull_refused, port_in_use (8888 and 9000 name different ports in one phrase shape) - six phrases pairwise different incl. the generic line
